trajectory_summary: This is a short, procedurally clean verify run — the rep captured every qualifier (address, roof, ownership, interest, bill, credit) quickly and without friction. But the call ends without a booked appointment: the rep pivots to texting a bill-collection request and closes with 'we will keep in touch,' never proposing a day or time. The energy is flat throughout — no real rapport build, no anchor on the $600 bill, and no locked next step.
outcome_dispute: The call never produces a specific day/time appointment; it ends on a vague 'we will keep in touch' with a bill-collection text promised. This should be scored no_appointment (or at best callback without a locked time), not booked/tentative, since no scheduling occurred at all — the entire final beat of the script (appointment_set, button_up) was skipped.
